SELECT circuitId, country, round_average, round_average - country_average AS difference
FROM (
  SELECT circuitId, country, round_average,
         AVG(round_average) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_average
  FROM (
    SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS round_average
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
  )
)
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
